name: Shotwick Road 2 data centre candidate site
notes: Flintshire LDP candidate alternative sites paper lists Deeside DEE005-AS Shotwick Road 2 as a 16 ha commercial candidate site where the submission proposed a data centre; council assessment says the site should not be allocated for a data centre and should remain in the Sealand-Cheshire Boundary green barrier. name: Bryn Coch Business Park / former Ferodo factory data centre campus
notes: Scoping/planning documents submitted to Cyngor Gwynedd describe redevelopment of the former Ferodo/Friction Dynamics site near Caernarfon/Y Felinheli for data centre buildings and substations. Public planning documents identify a roughly 38 ha site; DCD reports documents suggesting up to five buildings and about 300,000 sqm total. Capacity not disclosed.

name: North Wales AI Growth Zone - Trawsfynydd site
developer: North Wales AI Growth Zone consortium including Stena Line, Isle of Anglesey County Council, Bangor University and regional bodies
notes: UK Government confirmed a North Wales AI Growth Zone with a Trawsfynydd, Gwynedd location. DCD reports the zone is intended to accelerate large-scale AI infrastructure, but an investment partner had not yet been secured and no specific capacity for Trawsfynydd was disclosed.

name: GCRE Energy and Data Centre Partner opportunity
developer: Global Centre of Rail Excellence Ltd; investment partner to be selected
notes: GCRE is seeking an Energy and Data Centre Partner for its 700 ha former opencast mine/rail excellence site. Sell2Wales notice address is Onllwyn, Neath Port Talbot, and the site spans South Wales local-authority boundaries. Capacity not disclosed; partner procurement/competition was extended into 2026.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Vantage Cardiff / CWL1 campus
notes: Operational Vantage/NGD campus at/near Newport marketed as Vantage Cardiff CWL1. Vantage site says 2,000,000 sq ft and 148MW+ upgradeable power availability; DCD reports 148MW of power, two operational data centers and another planned.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Microsoft Newport Imperial Park datacentre
notes: Microsoft community page identifies the Imperial Park/former Quinn Radiators plant project in Newport. Business News Wales says the former Quinn Radiators factory is 1.1 million sq ft on 40 acres and planning permission was secured in July 2024 for 750,000 sq ft across data halls. DCD reports Microsoft is building two large data centers there; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Era4 modular AI data centre at Liberty Steel Newport
notes: DCD reports Newport City Council granted change-of-use permission for Era4 to use an existing building on part of the Liberty Steel plant in Newport for modular AI data centers. Application did not disclose IT capacity or opening date.
